---
title: "Get OSM data"
format: gfm
---


To get OSM data into R, we'll use the `osmextract` package and then the `osmactive` package to get active travel specific information.

```{r}
#| label: install-packages
#| include: false
# Install the pak package if you don't have it already
if (!requireNamespace("pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pak")
}
pkgs <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "osmextract",
  "nptscot/osmactive"
)
pak::pak(pkgs)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| result: hide
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(osmextract)
library(osmactive)
```

```{r}
#| label: case-study-area
case_study_name <- "Cardiff, UK"

```
